title: Localize Skill idea library content
context: SkillsScreen's eight built-in Skill idea cards use Vietnamese-only title, group, and description strings directly. When the app language is English, these cards remain Vietnamese despite the language setting.
goal: Route Skill idea titles, categories, and descriptions through the app's localization catalogs so the idea library follows the selected language.
forbidden_changes: Do not install or execute idea-library entries as Skills.
Do not change Skill discovery, authorization, or runtime behavior.
Do not translate Skill IDs or manifest-supplied content.
Do not change existing Vietnamese display values.
acceptance_criteria: Skill idea titles, groups, and descriptions are rendered through LocalizedStringKey.
English catalog provides English values for all 21 idea-library labels and descriptions.
Vietnamese catalog preserves the existing Vietnamese values.
No duplicate localization keys are introduced.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Static check confirms every idea-library key exists in both catalogs and no duplicate keys exist.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if catalog parsing, localization lookup, or the Apple build regresses.
